# IconToggleButton

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:icon-toggle-button` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A standalone icon-only toggle with a single contained toolbar group's geometry and pressed chrome.

## When to use

Render an icon-only aria-pressed toggle in content or a pane footer, where a Toolbar does not belong, with the 44px contained geometry and raised pressed face of a single ToolbarControlGroup.

- An icon-only on/off control (show a panel, a conversation) sits in content or a pane footer outside any Toolbar.

**Not when:**

- Do not use inside a Toolbar; compose a ToolbarControlGroup there.
- Do not use for a momentary action; use IconButton.
- Do not use for one-of-several choices; use SegmentedControl.

**Alternatives:**

- [ToolbarControlGroup](./toolbar-control-group.md) (nearest) — Inside a Toolbar, a single ToolbarControlGroup with a pressed button is the same control.
- [IconButton](./icon-button.md) (nearest) — Use IconButton for a momentary icon-only action.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/icon-toggle-button` — exports `IconToggleButton`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/icon-toggle-button` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/icon-toggle-button.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the pressed state and its delegated action; the accessible name.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Native button with aria-pressed and a required aria-label; with help tags registered it shows that label on hover and keyboard focus.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-icon-toggle-button`, `kui-icon-toggle-button__face`.

Never put `kui-icon-toggle-button`, `kui-icon-toggle-button__face` on an element you write; render `IconToggleButton` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-neutral-fill-normal`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-color-brand-on-quiet`, `--kui-shadow-s`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-layout-pill-radius`, `--kui-layout-rounded-radius`, `--kui-layout-highlight-inset`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
